def factor_drawdown_nosmoothed_atr10(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    high = df_copy['high']
    low = df_copy['low']
    close = df_copy['close']
    resvol_high = df_copy['style_gate_resvol_high'] > 0
    max_high_highvol = high.rolling(40, min_periods=20).max()
    max_high_lowvol = high.rolling(60, min_periods=20).max()
    max_high = np.where(resvol_high, max_high_highvol, max_high_lowvol)
    drawdown = (max_high - close) / max_high
    drawdown = drawdown.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    atr = talib.ATR(high.values.astype(np.float64),
                    low.values.astype(np.float64),
                    close.values.astype(np.float64),
                    timeperiod=10)
    atr_series = pd.Series(atr, index=df_copy.index)
    factor = drawdown / atr_series.replace(0, np.nan)
    df_copy['factor_drawdown_nosmoothed_atr10'] = factor
    return df_copy['factor_drawdown_nosmoothed_atr10']

This regime adaptation improves the raw signal's relevance by aligning the lookback with market conditions.
